meta.name: docs-page
meta.description: 三栏文档页: 侧导航 + 正文 + 右 TOC

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速搭建带侧导航和目录的文档页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为项目生成结构清晰的文档页面
copy.tagline_en: Quickly build a documentation page with sidebar and table of contents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate a well-structured documentation page for your project

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按这套模板产出技术文档单页:左侧分区导航(吸顶)、中间正文(含代码块、提示框、表格)、右侧目录(吸顶、随滚动高亮),顶栏还带搜索、版本与主题切换。
howto.when: 当你要求生成 API 文档、教程或指南类单页,需要长文阅读布局时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个 API 文档页,左侧放导航、右侧放目录
say.note: 输出三栏布局的单页文档

say.text: 把这份教程做成文档页,代码块要带复制按钮
say.note: 代码块为圆角深色、带语言标签

say.text: 文档页里加一个警告提示框和版本切换
say.note: 提示框用 info / warn / danger 三色

howto.what_en: Claude builds a three-column docs page: sticky section nav on the left, article body with code blocks, callouts and tables, scroll-spy TOC on the right, and a top bar with search, version and theme toggle.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for an API doc, tutorial or guide page that needs a single long-read layout.

say_en.text: Build an API docs page with left nav and a right-side TOC.
Turn this tutorial into a docs page; code blocks with copy buttons.
say_en.note: Code blocks are rounded and dark.

say_en.text: Add a warning callout and a version switcher to the docs page.
say_en.note: Callouts use info / warn / danger colors.
